value.rationale: The two-observation budget is the smallest nontrivial simultaneous coverage-versus-replication choice for noisy Matérn Bayesian integration. The sharp positive-noise collision and linear approach law are a motivated structural threshold beyond routine formula substitution, giving exact design guidance within the natural reflection-symmetric class without overstating unrestricted global optimality.
